summary: The Mac app ensures axod is registered with launchd and running the same build as the app.
trigger: app launch or explicit user action

steps.action: resolve registration decision from SMAppService status and recorded intent
properties: registers only once automatically; user-disabled is respected

steps.action: register the bundled daemon as a per-user LaunchAgent
compare daemon build number to app build number; on mismatch ask launchd to restart the service from the current bundle
